"""Combined worst-case workload: max aggregates in a single process."""
import json, random, resource, subprocess, sys, time, importlib.util, importlib.machinery
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader('sub', importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('sub', '/app/submit/run'))
sub = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sub)
rng = random.Random(2024)

def deep_fib(n):
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        a = (i << (128 - 11)) | rng.getrandbits(117)
        out.append({'prefix': sub.fmt_prefix(a, 128), 'hop': i % 65536})
    return out

lines = []
# 4 maximal compiles (aggregate FIB 8192)
for k in range(4):
    lines.append(json.dumps({"op": "compile", "fib": deep_fib(2048),
                             "capacities": [1000000000] * 16, "max_stride": 32}))
# get one image back for the lookup part
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=(lines[0] + '\n').encode(),
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
img = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('image response bytes:', len(p.stdout))
# 4 maximal-image lookups (aggregate image FIB 8192) + 50000 addresses total
for k, cnt in enumerate((20000, 20000, 10000)):
    lines.append(json.dumps({"op": "lookup", "image": img,
                             "addresses": [sub.fmt_addr(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(cnt)]}))
# pad to 200 requests with small valid ones
for k in range(200 - len(lines)):
    lines.append(json.dumps({"op": "compile", "fib": [{"prefix": "::/0", "hop": 1}],
                             "capacities": [4096] * 4, "max_stride": 32}))
data = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('total input bytes: %.1f MB, requests: %d' % (len(data) / 1e6, len(lines)))
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=data.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=200)
dt = time.time() - t
assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr[-2000:]
res = [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
print('responses:', len(res), 'time: %.2fs' % dt)
print('max response bytes:', max(len(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()))
bad = [i for i, r in enumerate(res) if r['status'] != 'ok']
print('non-ok:', bad[:5], len(bad))
usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('child peak RSS: %.0f MB' % (usage.ru_maxrss / 1024))
assert not bad
print('COMBINED WORST CASE OK')
EOF
cd /app/tmp && time python3 test_worst.py
